Call a Window Expert — (385) 200-1021 Text a Window Expert What Are Full-Home Window Replacement? A full-home window replacement is the most comprehensive window upgrade a homeowner can make. By replacing every window at once, you achieve consistent energy performance throughout the home, uniform aesthetics from the inside and outside, and the best per-window pricing we offer. At Revival Windows, full-home replacements are our specialty. We’ve replaced thousands of windows across hundreds of homes, and our process is designed to minimize disruption while maximizing results. Most full-home projects are completed in 1-2 days, and our team handles everything from measurement and manufacturing to installation, cleanup, and warranty registration. The result is a home that looks better, feels more comfortable, and costs less to heat and cool — starting from day one. Why It Matters Why Full-Home Window Replacement Matter for Your Home Replacing windows one or two at a time over several years means living with mismatched performance, inconsistent appearance, and higher per-window costs. Older windows continue to waste energy while you wait, and the cumulative cost of multiple small projects often exceeds what a single full-home replacement would have cost. By doing everything at once, you lock in today’s pricing, maximize volume discounts, and start saving energy immediately across every window in your home. Full-home replacement also ensures a consistent appearance — all windows match in color, style, and hardware, creating a cohesive look that enhances curb appeal and interior aesthetics. Our Process How We Install Full-Home Window Replacement 01 Comprehensive whole-home consultation — we assess every window, identify priorities, and discuss your goals and budget 02 Custom measurement of every window opening in the home 03 Product selection — we help you choose consistent styles, colors, and glass packages for a unified look 04 Factory fabrication of all windows simultaneously for efficient production 05 Coordinated installation — our team works systematically through the home, typically completing 10-15 windows per day 06 Final walkthrough of every window, operational testing, cleanup, and warranty registration for the entire home Benefits Key Benefits of Full-Home Window Replacement Best Pricing Full-home projects receive our best per-window pricing — typically 10-15% less than replacing windows individually over time. Maximum Energy Savings Every window in your home performs at peak efficiency from day one — no weak links in your thermal envelope. Consistent Appearance All windows match in color, style, and hardware for a cohesive look inside and out. One-Time Disruption Complete the entire project in 1-2 days instead of scheduling multiple installations over months or years. Simplified Warranty One warranty covers every window in your home — easy to track and manage. Financing Available Flexible financing options make full-home replacement achievable for most budgets. Technical Specifications Technical Details & Specifications Full-home replacements are planned and executed as a coordinated project. We create a detailed installation schedule that prioritizes weather-exposed windows first and works systematically through the home to minimize the time any opening is exposed. Each window is pre-staged and labeled for its specific opening to ensure efficient installation. Our crews typically install 10-15 windows per day depending on size and complexity. For homes with 20+ windows, we may deploy multiple crews to complete the project in a single day. All windows receive the same precision installation — proper shimming, insulation, sealing, and finishing — regardless of project size. Your Free In-Home Estimate What to Expect for Full-Home Window Replacement Full-home window replacement pricing depends on the number of windows, sizes, types, and glass packages selected. Volume pricing reduces the per-window cost compared to individual replacements, making a complete upgrade more affordable than most homeowners expect. We offer flexible financing with monthly payments to make full-home projects achievable. Schedule a free whole-home consultation to get a detailed, itemized quote tailored to your home. Every project is unique — that's why we quote on-site, not online. During your free in-home consultation, our window expert will assess your current windows, take precise measurements, and present tailored options with no pressure. Call for a Free Estimate — (385) 200-1021 Warning Signs Signs You Need Full-Home Window Replacement If you notice any of these warning signs, it may be time to consider upgrading. Don’t wait until small problems become expensive repairs. 1 Most or all of your windows are 15-20+ years old 2 Energy bills are high and you want maximum savings from a single project 3 Your home's windows are a mix of ages, styles, or conditions that look inconsistent 4 You're preparing your home for sale and want to maximize curb appeal and value 5 Multiple windows show signs of failure — drafts, fog, difficulty operating, or visible damage 6 You want to take advantage of volume pricing and get the best per-window cost Frequently Asked Questions About Full-Home Window Replacement How long does a full-home window replacement take? Most full-home projects (10-20 windows) are completed in 1-2 days. Larger homes may take 2-3 days. We schedule the project around your availability and keep your home secure throughout. Do I need to be home during installation? We recommend being home for the initial walkthrough and final inspection. During installation, our team works independently and will contact you if any questions arise. Can I finance a full-home replacement? Yes. We offer flexible financing options with competitive rates and manageable monthly payments. Ask about current promotions during your free consultation. Call a Window Expert — (385) 200-1021 Text a Window Expert What Are Window Replacement? Window replacement is the core of what we do at Revival Windows. Whether you’re replacing a single damaged window or upgrading every window in your home, our process is designed to deliver a seamless experience from consultation to completion. We handle both retrofit replacements (installing new windows into existing frames) and full-frame replacements (removing the entire window assembly down to the rough opening) depending on the condition of your existing windows and your goals for the project. Every replacement window is custom-measured, factory-built to your exact specifications, and installed by our trained in-house team — always handled by our trained team. We work with homeowners to select the right window type, frame material, glass package, and style for each opening, ensuring that every window performs optimally and complements your home’s architecture. Why It Matters Why Window Replacement Matter for Your Home Windows are one of the most visible and functional elements of your home. Old, inefficient, or damaged windows affect everything — your energy bills, your comfort, your home’s appearance, and even its security. According to the National Association of Realtors, window replacement consistently ranks among the top home improvement projects for return on investment, with homeowners typically recouping 60-70% of the project cost at resale. Beyond financial returns, new windows deliver immediate quality-of-life improvements: lower energy bills, more consistent indoor temperatures, reduced outside noise, easier operation, and improved curb appeal. For homes with windows that are 15-20+ years old, replacement isn’t just an upgrade — it’s a necessary maintenance investment that protects the home’s structure and value. Our Process How We Install Window Replacement 01 Free in-home consultation — we assess every window, discuss your priorities, and provide honest recommendations 02 Custom measurement of each window opening with precision tools to ensure a perfect fit 03 Product selection — we help you choose the right window type, glass package, and style for each opening 04 Factory fabrication of your custom windows to exact specifications 05 Professional installation by our trained team with proper insulation, sealing, and finishing 06 Post-installation walkthrough, operational testing, and lifetime warranty registration Benefits Key Benefits of Window Replacement Energy Savings New windows reduce heating and cooling costs by 12-33% depending on the windows being replaced and your climate zone. Increased Home Value Window replacement delivers one of the highest ROIs of any home improvement project — typically 60-70% cost recovery at resale. Improved Comfort Eliminate drafts, hot spots, and cold zones. New windows maintain consistent temperatures throughout your home. Noise Reduction Multi-pane windows with gas fills significantly reduce outside noise — traffic, neighbors, aircraft, and more. Enhanced Security Modern windows feature stronger locks, more durable frames, and optional impact-resistant glass for improved home security. Curb Appeal New windows transform your home’s appearance from the outside and brighten every room from the inside. Technical Specifications Technical Details & Specifications We offer two primary replacement methods. Retrofit (insert) replacement installs a new window unit inside the existing frame, which is ideal when the frame is in good condition and you want to minimize disruption and cost. Full-frame replacement removes the entire window assembly — including the frame, trim, and sometimes the sill — and installs a completely new unit into the rough opening. This method is recommended when the existing frame is damaged, rotted, or improperly installed. Both methods include proper insulation of the gap between the window and the rough opening using low-expansion foam, backer rod, or fiberglass insulation as appropriate. Exterior and interior trim is finished to match the existing home aesthetic. Because every home and project is different, we provide detailed, itemized quotes during a free in-home consultation rather than publishing generic ranges. Full-home replacements benefit from volume pricing, and we offer flexible financing options for larger projects. No hidden fees, no surprises — just transparent pricing based on your specific needs. Every project is unique — that's why we quote on-site, not online. During your free in-home consultation, our window expert will assess your current windows, take precise measurements, and present tailored options with no pressure. Don’t wait until small problems become expensive repairs. 1 Your windows are 15-20+ years old and showing signs of wear 2 Energy bills have been increasing despite normal usage 3 Windows are difficult to open, close, or lock 4 Visible damage — cracks, rot, warping, or seal failures 5 You feel drafts near closed windows 6 Outside noise is noticeably loud through closed windows 7 Condensation forms between the panes of double-pane windows Frequently Asked Questions About Window Replacement How long does window replacement take? Most individual window replacements take 1-2 hours per window. A full-home replacement of 10-20 windows typically takes 1-2 days. We schedule around your availability and keep your home secure throughout the process. Do I need to replace all my windows at once? No. While full-home replacement maximizes energy savings and provides a consistent appearance, you can replace windows in phases based on priority and budget. We often recommend starting with the most damaged or least efficient windows. What's the difference between retrofit and full-frame replacement? Retrofit replacement installs a new window inside the existing frame — it's faster and less expensive. Full-frame replacement removes everything down to the rough opening — it's more thorough and recommended when the existing frame is damaged. Will new windows really lower my energy bills? Yes. ENERGY STAR-certified windows can reduce heating and cooling costs by 12-33% depending on what you're replacing and your climate. We provide a projected savings analysis during your free consultation.
